name: IBIT Short Volume Ratio Sentiment
description: Research study analyzing FINRA short volume ratio as a sentiment indicator for IBIT (iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF). Computes short_volume / total_volume, overlays a 20-day SMA, and identifies bearish-majority days (ratio > 50%).
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC SHORT VOLUME RATIO — SENTIMENT INDICATOR
# =============================================================================
# Data: FINRA short volume (daily short sale volume from off-exchange venues)
# Metric: short_volume / total_volume (already provided as short_volume_ratio)
# Context: 20-day SMA smoothing, 50% bearish-majority threshold
# Note: short_volume is FINRA stock data — crypto coverage may be limited
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# SHORT VOLUME DATA
# =============================================================================

sv_data = short_volume()()
short_vol = sv_data.short_volume
total_vol = sv_data.total_volume
sv_ratio = sv_data.short_volume_ratio  # Already in percentage units (0-100)

# 20-day SMA of the short volume ratio
sv_ratio_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(sv_ratio)

# =============================================================================
# DERIVED METRICS
# =============================================================================

# Bearish majority: days where short volume > 50% of total
is_bearish_majority = sv_ratio > 50
bearish_flag = 1.0 if is_bearish_majority else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Key Short Volume Ratio Stats ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='IBIT Short Volume Ratio Summary',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Short Vol Ratio'],
        col_headers=['Avg Ratio', 'Current Ratio', 'Max Ratio', 'Min Ratio', '% Days > 50%'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    order=0
)(sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio, bearish_flag)

# --- 2. XY Lines: BTC Price Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='IBIT Price',
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='Price (USD)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='IBIT Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, close)

# --- 3. XY Lines: Short Volume Ratio + 20-SMA + 50% Reference ---
xy_lines(
    title='Short Volume Ratio with 20-Day SMA',
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='Short Volume Ratio (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Short Vol Ratio', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day SMA', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% Bearish Threshold')
    ]),
    order=2
)(ts, sv_ratio, sv_ratio_sma)

# --- 4. Histogram: Distribution of Short Volume Ratio ---
histogram(
    title='Short Volume Ratio Distribution',
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Short Volume Ratio (%)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=3
)(sv_ratio)
